استأببت (form X)
# اِسْتَأْبَبْتُ (istaʔbabtu) /is.taʔ.bab.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# اِسْتَأْبَبْتَ (istaʔbabta) /is.taʔ.bab.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
# اِسْتَأْبَبْتِ (istaʔbabti) /is.taʔ.bab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَأَبَّ (istaʔabba)
